summary: Implementation plan to resolve the critical SEO tag issues identified in the WebsiteCrawler audit: trimming all SSR and client-side page titles to <= 65 characters and meta descriptions to <= 160 characters, removing deprecated meta keywords tags, and scoping the homepage JSON-LD @graph schema strictly to the root path ("/") while preserving lightweight Organization reference nodes on subpages so all 8,990 structured data warnings are eliminated.
